title: Fix unreachable live site and add connectivity diagnostics for Luxeoushub

requirements.text: Add a public-facing connectivity error state on the storefront homepage that detects when the app cannot reach the deployed backend canister (e.g., fetch/query failures) and shows a clear English message explaining that the site is temporarily unreachable, along with a “Retry” action and the current page URL (window.location.origin + window.location.href) to help the owner share the correct link.

quotes: I am trying to publish my website draft, but when I open the link, I get the message: “This site can’t be reached.”
Make my draft publicly accessible, and
Ensure it can be reached via a live URL so I can share it with my customers.

acceptanceCriteria: When backend actor calls fail due to network/unreachable errors, the Home page renders a visible, non-technical English error banner/section instead of silently failing.
The error UI includes a Retry button that re-attempts the failed query/queries.
The error UI displays the current URL so the site owner can confirm/copy what they are sharing.
When the backend is reachable again, the error UI disappears and normal storefront sections render.

requirements.text: Implement a simple public backend health-check query method in the single Motoko main actor that returns a static OK response (and optionally a backend version string) so the frontend can reliably distinguish “backend reachable” vs “backend unreachable”.

quotes: I get the message: “This site can’t be reached.”
Ensure it can be reached via a live URL so I can share it with my customers.

acceptanceCriteria: A new public query function (e.g., health/status) exists on the backend actor and returns a deterministic OK payload without requiring authentication.
Calling the health-check does not mutate state and does not require any roles/permissions.
If the backend canister is running and reachable, the health-check call succeeds consistently.

requirements.text: Update the custom domain / publishing documentation to include a troubleshooting section specifically for the browser error “This site can’t be reached”, including a checklist to verify DNS records, platform domain mapping, and a way to confirm a working live URL (both the platform-provided URL and the custom domain URL once configured). Keep all user-facing text in English.

quotes: Could you please help me: Make my draft publicly accessible, and Ensure it can be reached via a live URL so I can share it with my customers.

acceptanceCriteria: The documentation file frontend/docs/custom-domain-luxeoushub.com.md contains actionable steps for verifying DNS and domain mapping and a troubleshooting checklist for “This site can’t be reached”.
The troubleshooting section includes guidance to test reachability using the platform-provided live URL before testing the custom domain.
All added documentation text is written in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko architecture with all logic in backend/main.mo (additions allowed, no extra backend services).

Do not modify any frontend files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Do not introduce third-party auth providers; Internet Identity remains the only supported auth mechanism.
nonGoals: Registering the domain with a registrar or making DNS changes on behalf of the user (documentation/checklists only).
Submitting the site to Google or handling Google Search Console setup as part of this build.
Adding new product features, new site pages, or changing the storefront merchandising sections unrelated to reachability.
